text: Assuming all Guards and Houdinis lie on the fitted Elo lines with no saturation, the paper predicts oversight success at a 400-point general Elo gap ranging from 9.4% for Wargames to 51.7% for Debate, noting that a random judge already gets 50% in Debate so its curve converges to about 50%. Win probability generally falls as Delta_general grows, n* increases with Delta_general where mG > mH (Mafia, Debate, Wargames), and Backdoor Code has a zone where two steps are optimal.
title: Predicted NSO success at a 400-point general Elo gap: 51.7% Debate, 9.4% Wargames
